readerCopy.body: An obligation can look completely different once it becomes obvious that the arrangement works only because one person keeps absorbing the part nobody else wants. When Saturn conjoins Lilith, duty and refusal fuse, making a role, promise, contract, or responsibility harder to carry under the old terms. The commitment can still matter without every condition attached to it deserving to survive. The arrangement becomes more honest when responsibility is redistributed instead of hidden inside the person most accustomed to taking it.
